observations: The runtime supplied no subagent/task identity, so task is null. I opened works/auto-6294ee8a2094/workflow/review/page-03.png with Read and looked at it. For the 02-4→03-1 transition I also opened page-02.png, and for 03-5→04-1 page-04.png.
All lettering matches the source page 3 word for word: the four captions, 'Every check-in gets a slot on the screen.' and the TV label 'A-10 · A-11 · A-12'.

03-1: the caption 'A later morning: patients can always check in at the front desk.' sits on the upper-left wall. Its right edge reaches the left edge of a small wall screen behind Meera, which shows only a blank strip and has no lettering assigned. The faces of Mr. Raman and Meera, Meera's typing hands, his hand on the walking stick and the QR stand at far left are all clear.
03-2: the caption 'Some check in ahead on the Welbuk Health app.' ends just above Priya's hair. Her face, her tapping index finger and the phone with its calendar and check icons are clear.

03-3: the right end of the caption 'Ravi scans the QR code at the door.' touches only the top-left of Ravi's hair. His brows, eyes and mouth are below it, and the QR stand, the phone with its scan frame and his hand on the bag strap are clear.

03-4: the caption 'A short form on his own phone, shared with consent.' sits left of Ravi's face and above the phone. The form fields, the tick-box being tapped, the thumb and the wristwatch are clear.

03-5: the caption is on the plain upper-left wall. The label 'A-10 · A-11 · A-12' sits inside the wall TV's screen, on its strip, in one line. All three faces, the walking stick, both phones and the bag on Ravi's lap are clear.
The page has no speech balloons, so there are no tails to check.
My natural left-to-right scan goes top-left caption, top-right caption, middle-left, middle-right, bottom caption, then the TV label. This is the script order.

Every caption sits in its own panel's top-left corner. No neighbouring text boxes from different panels compete, so no box can be skipped or read out of order. The TV label is read last, as the result of the three check-ins.

transitions.observation: The evening office with the onboarding laptop cuts to a bright reception desk. 'A later morning' marks the time change explicitly, and Meera in the same blue kurta and braid anchors the place.
A second route: Priya checks in on the app outside the same clinic, recognisable by its teal awning and the reception visible through the glass.
A third route: Ravi at the QR stand just inside the entrance. Meera, Mr. Raman and Priya are visible behind him, which ties the three panels together.
A close-up of the same phone after the scan, showing the form and the consent tick. The green sleeve and the wristwatch are continuous.
All three patients sit together under the TV, in the order front desk, app, QR. Ravi's phone and the bag on his lap are continuous.

The same waiting room and wall TV. 'A-10 · A-11 · A-12' becomes 'NOW · A-12', the chairs beside Ravi are empty, and he stands with his bag back on his shoulder. The caption 'Soon, his slot comes up.' bridges the page turn.

readingReview.comparison: The first reading's order matches the script exactly. (a) The 03-1 caption does meet the background wall screen, but that screen is blank and has no information assigned, so it is not a lettering defect. (b) The 03-2 caption is close to Priya's hair but does not reach her face. (c) Hair continuity and (d) the unnamed patients concern the art and the source, not lettering. Nothing unresolved remains.
